This '''Unidentified cantina''' was located outside the city of [[Pilaan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]. It had a poorly kept outside appearance with its [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] windows mud-spotted and colored brown.<ref name="target" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], a few months after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] members [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[X-7]], the latter of whom the other Rebels were unaware was actually an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] secretly using the alias Tobin Elad, went to the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] to gather some information about their missing Rebel contact [[Mak Luunim]].<ref name="target" />
